hg: rfd requirements kahan hai
rfd screen menu me nahi hai

a.en: Open Fabric Inventory, pick Fabric flow, choose the Printers stage and press By printer; it opens RFD Requirements showing the cloth with each printer.
a.hi: Fabric Inventory खोलें, Fabric flow चुनें, Printers स्टेज चुनकर By printer दबाएँ; RFD Requirements खुलकर हर प्रिंटर के पास का कपड़ा दिखाता है।
a.hg: Fabric Inventory kholiye, Fabric flow chuniye, Printers stage chunkar By printer dabaiye; RFD Requirements khulkar har printer ke paas ka kapda dikhata hai.

hi: RFD में कौन से व्यू हैं
hg: rfd me kaun se view hain
to send column ka matlab

a.en: The first drop-down has Requirements raised, By order — needs · sent · received and By printer — cloth with them; in By order, To send is what still has to go out.
a.hi: पहले ड्रॉप-डाउन में Requirements raised, By order — needs · sent · received और By printer — cloth with them हैं; By order में To send वह है जो अभी भेजना बाकी है।
a.hg: Pehle drop-down me Requirements raised, By order — needs · sent · received aur By printer — cloth with them hain; By order me To send woh hai jo abhi bhejna baaki hai.

hi: ऑर्डर के लिए RFD कैसे भेजें
hg: order ke liye rfd kaise bheje
printer ko kapda kaise bheje

a.en: In By order — needs · sent · received press Send … on the row, check the quantity and Date it goes out, then press Record it.
a.hi: By order — needs · sent · received में लाइन पर Send … दबाएँ, मात्रा और Date it goes out जाँचें, फिर Record it दबाएँ।
a.hg: By order — needs · sent · received me row par Send … dabaiye, quantity aur Date it goes out check kijiye, phir Record it dabaiye.

hg: rfd requirement approve kaise kare
printer ne zyada kapda maanga hai

a.en: On a waiting row press Approve, write Why you are allowing it, and save; you are giving cloth beyond what the order covers.
a.hi: इंतज़ार वाली लाइन पर Approve दबाएँ, Why you are allowing it लिखें और सेव करें; आप ऑर्डर से ज़्यादा कपड़ा दे रहे हैं।
a.hg: Waiting wali row par Approve dabaiye, Why you are allowing it likhiye aur save kijiye; aap order se zyada kapda de rahe hain.

hg: rfd requirement refuse kaise kare
ek saath kai rfd refuse kaise kare

a.en: Press Refuse on the row and write a Reason; for many, tick the rows and press Refuse ticked, then write one reason.
a.hi: लाइन पर Refuse दबाएँ और Reason लिखें; कई के लिए लाइनें टिक करके Refuse ticked दबाएँ, फिर एक कारण लिखें।
a.hg: Row par Refuse dabaiye aur Reason likhiye; kai ke liye rows tick karke Refuse ticked dabaiye, phir ek reason likhiye.

en: fabric has already gone out against this one
hi: कपड़ा जाने के बाद मना क्यों नहीं हो रहा
hg: fabric has already gone out aa raha hai
kapda bhejne ke baad refuse kyu nahi ho raha

a.en: Cloth has already been sent against this requirement, so it cannot be refused now; refusing would not bring the cloth back.
a.hi: इस रिक्वायरमेंट पर कपड़ा पहले ही भेजा जा चुका है, इसलिए अब इसे मना नहीं किया जा सकता; मना करने से कपड़ा वापस नहीं आएगा।
a.hg: Is requirement par kapda pehle hi bheja ja chuka hai, isliye ab ise refuse nahi kar sakte; refuse karne se kapda wapas nahi aayega.

hg: rfd bheja kaise darj kare
mark sent nahi ho raha

a.en: On an approved row press Mark sent, fill the metres or pieces going out, Date it goes out and Remarks, then press Record it.
a.hi: मंज़ूर लाइन पर Mark sent दबाएँ, जाने वाले मीटर या पीस, Date it goes out और Remarks भरें, फिर Record it दबाएँ।
a.hg: Approved row par Mark sent dabaiye, jaane wale metre ya pieces, Date it goes out aur Remarks bhariye, phir Record it dabaiye.

en: answering an rfd requirement needs permission
marking rfd fabric as sent needs permission
hg: rfd approve karne ki permission
rfd me button nahi dikh rahe

a.en: Approve and Refuse need "Can approve RFD requirements", and Mark sent needs "Can mark RFD fabric sent"; ask an admin to switch on the one your work needs.
a.hi: Approve और Refuse के लिए "Can approve RFD requirements", और Mark sent के लिए "Can mark RFD fabric sent" चाहिए; जो आपके काम का है, वह एडमिन से चालू करवाएँ।
a.hg: Approve aur Refuse ke liye "Can approve RFD requirements", aur Mark sent ke liye "Can mark RFD fabric sent" chahiye; jo aapke kaam ka hai, woh admin se chalu karwaiye.

en: is a production flow order its rfd goes on a challan
cannot send rfd for ppc order
hi: PPC ऑर्डर का RFD यहाँ से क्यों नहीं जा रहा
hg: ppc order ka rfd yahan se kyu nahi ja raha
its rfd goes on a challan aa raha hai

a.en: That is a Production flow order: its RFD goes on a challan in PPC · Production flow → Demand → RFD fabric · out to printers, not here.
a.hi: यह Production flow ऑर्डर है: इसका RFD PPC · Production flow → Demand → RFD fabric · out to printers में चालान पर जाता है, यहाँ से नहीं।
a.hg: Yeh Production flow order hai: iska RFD PPC · Production flow → Demand → RFD fabric · out to printers me challan par jaata hai, yahan se nahi.

en: when is rfd requirement auto approved
hi: आरएफडी रिक्वेस्ट अपने आप अप्रूव कब होती है
hg: rfd request apne aap approve kab hoti hai
order par kitna rfd kapda mil sakta hai

a.en: An RFD ask is agreed on its own when it fits inside what its order still needs: running lines give their metres, cut lines give pieces × the SKU’s consumption, less what was already asked and less what the printer say…
a.hi: आरएफडी माँग अपने आप मान ली जाती है जब वह ऑर्डर की बची ज़रूरत के अंदर हो: रनिंग लाइन अपने मीटर देती है, कट लाइन पीस × SKU का कंजम्पशन, उसमें से पहले माँगा हुआ और प्रिंटर के पास पहले से पड़ा कपड़ा घटाकर। इससे ऊपर का अप्…
a.hg: RFD maang apne aap maan li jaati hai jab wo order ki bachi zaroorat ke andar ho: running line apne metre deti hai, cut line pieces × SKU ka consumption, usme se pehle maanga hua aur printer ke paas pehle se pada kapda…

en: why rfd asks pieces for tablecloth
hi: आरएफडी मीटर में या पीस में
hg: rfd meter me ya piece me
tablecloth ka rfd piece me kyu

a.en: The Printing rule in Masters decides: a line handed over cut is asked for in pieces of a size, everything else in metres of cloth. A running line is always metres; a cut line with no rule is treated as pieces.
a.hi: Masters का Printing rule तय करता है: जो लाइन कटी हुई दी जाती है वह साइज़ के पीस में माँगी जाती है, बाकी सब कपड़े के मीटर में। रनिंग लाइन हमेशा मीटर में; बिना नियम वाली कट लाइन पीस में मानी जाती है।
a.hg: Masters ka Printing rule tay karta hai: jo line kati hui di jaati hai wo size ke pieces me maangi jaati hai, baaki sab kapde ke metre me. Running line hamesha metre me; bina rule wali cut line pieces me maani j…

hg: rfd stage ka matlab
approved not yet sent kya hai

a.en: Waiting for approval = over what the order covers and nobody has answered; Approved, not yet sent = agreed (by a person, or automatically inside the order) but the cloth has not gone; Fabric sent …
a.hi: Waiting for approval = ऑर्डर से ऊपर और किसी ने जवाब नहीं दिया; Approved, not yet sent = मंज़ूर (किसी व्यक्ति ने, या ऑर्डर के अंदर होने से अपने आप) पर कपड़ा नहीं गया; Fabric sent = माँगा हुआ भेजा म…
a.hg: Waiting for approval = order se upar aur kisi ne jawab nahi diya; Approved, not yet sent = manzoor (kisi vyakti ne, ya order ke andar hone se apne aap) par kapda nahi gaya; Fabric sent = maanga hu…

en: by printer cloth with them columns meaning
had received on the way delivered back
hi: By printer में कॉलम का मतलब
hg: by printer me column ka matlab
had received on the way delivered back kya hai

a.en: With them now = Had (the printer’s own count) + Received (lots they confirmed) − Delivered back (worked out from accepted deliveries). On the way is sent but not yet confirmed by them.
a.hi: With them now = Had (प्रिंटर की अपनी गिनती) + Received (जो लॉट उन्होंने पक्के किए) − Delivered back (एक्सेप्ट हुई डिलीवरी से निकला)। On the way = भेजा पर उन्होंने अभी पक्का नहीं किया।
a.hg: With them now = Had (printer ki apni ginti) + Received (jo lot unhone pakke kiye) − Delivered back (accept hui delivery se nikla). On the way = bheja par unhone abhi pakka nahi kiya.

en: why some rfd requests approved automatically
hi: कुछ RFD request अपने आप approve क्यों हो गईं
hg: kuch rfd request apne aap approve kyu ho gayi
nobody had to agree ka matlab

a.en: When a printer asks for RFD cloth or cut pieces, whatever is inside what that order covers is approved at once ("nobody had to agree"); only the part beyond it waits for someone with "Can approve RFD requirements".
a.hi: जब प्रिंटर RFD कपड़ा या कटे पीस माँगता है, तो जो उस ऑर्डर की सीमा के अंदर है वह तुरंत approve होता है ("nobody had to agree"); सिर्फ़ उससे ज़्यादा वाला हिस्सा "Can approve RFD requirements" वाले का इंतज़ार करता है।
a.hg: Jab printer RFD kapda ya kate piece maangta hai, to jo us order ki seema ke andar hai wo turant approve hota hai ("nobody had to agree"); sirf usse zyada wala hissa "Can approve RFD requirements" wale ka intezaar kart…
